name: t-SNE for Transfer Function Design
definition: A dimensionality reduction technique applied to multivariate voxels to create a 2D similarity plot, enabling the separation and segmentation of different phases or features (e.g., noise, bone, sarcoma) based on voxel similarity.
summary: t-SNE for Transfer Function Design uses Fast Semi-Supervised t-SNE to map multivariate voxel data into a 2D similarity plot, enabling efficient segmentation of volumetric features by combining semi-supervised constraints with Barnes-Hut approximation.
